description: This Java class configures email-related components for a Spring application, including JavaMailSender, Thymeleaf template engine, and message source for email templates.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up email sender, template engine, and message sources.

methods.name: getJavaMailSender
methods.description: Creates and configures a JavaMailSender bean with SMTP settings.

methods.name: thymeleafTemplateEngine
methods.description: Creates a SpringTemplateEngine bean configured with a template resolver and message source.

methods.name: thymeleafClassLoaderTemplateResolver
methods.description: Creates a template resolver bean for loading email templates from classpath.

methods.name: emailMessageSource
methods.description: Creates a message source bean for email message properties.
